name: Moonlit pillow sub-walk
desc: A deep sine sub-bass pillow crooning the 50s I-vi-IV-V doo-wop changes in C major: one long sustained root per bar under a slow filter breath, a dotted two-hit pump in the groove, and a peak that switches to a rounder sawtooth arpeggiated walk through root-fifth-third with an octave-down drop every eighth cycle. Softer, deeper and more melancholy than the croon walk.

code.full: note("<[c2 ~ c2 c2] [a1 ~ a1 a1] [f1 ~ f2 f1] [g1 ~ g1 g1]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.01).decay(.4).sustain(.6).release(.2).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.2).slow(20)).shape(.45).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.85,${gain}).fast(2)).room(${room}).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[c2 g2 c2 e2 g2 e2 c2 g1] [a1 e2 a1 c2 e2 c2 a1 e1] [f1 c2 f1 a1 c2 a1 f1 c1] [g1 d2 g1 b1 d2 b1 g1 d1]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.5).slow(10)).lpq(3).attack(.01).decay(.25).sustain(.4).release(.12).shape(.5).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.8,${gain}).fast(4)).room(${room}).every(8,x=>x.add(note(-12))).orbit(3).play()
